summary: Read-side workspace gremlin fixed, merged to main (8077439). Root cause: lib/mcp-core.js makeCall injected the session workspace only into POST bodies — GETs carried nothing, so MCP READ tools fell back to daemon-global state.workspace (wrong/stale after restart). Fix: makeCall now appends ?workspace= to every GET (explicit workspace= wins; pinning = stdio ORCH_WORKSPACE/cwd, re-sent per request, so it survives daemon restarts by construction). Daemon: buildGraph serves the TARGET workspace overlay (notes/summaries/assignee/git/metrics/timestamps/edges); /task/{detail,context,tree}, /state, /guidance GET, /git/status, /agents, /agent/stop-requested honor ?workspace=. Claim-release: releaseClaim/sweepStaleClaims parameterized on (ws,ov) — sweep releases in the workspace being read; /agent/done cascades into the AGENT recorded workspace; /agent/stop flags land in caller workspace. No param => old global fallback. Tests: new test/workspace-read-target.test.js (31/31) incl. live-symptom repro (detail 404 without workspace, 200 with); all 35 unit suites + smoke.sh (97/97) green pre- and post-merge. DAEMON NOT RESTARTED — fix rides the existing gated follow-up followup/restart-orchestrator-daemon-to-pick-up-v-6x5p. Known remaining gap (out of scope): HTTP /mcp connector transport has no per-session workspace (self-call still global); /judge/next cursor still global.

subject: Read-side workspace gremlin: MCP read tools + claim-release must honor session workspace
description:
Follow-up to the write-side fix (task #6, done — targetOverlay() pattern in daemon.js:152-164). The READ side still uses the daemon-global workspace: a session can now WRITE to its pinned workspace but READ the wrong graph.

SCOPE (flagged by the #6 worker, verified routes): MCP read tools — get_full_graph, search_knowledge (the /search route accepts ?workspace= but verify mcp-core forwards it on READS too), get_learnings, list_guidance, get_task_detail/context, etc. — plus /agent/stop + /agent/done claim-release and the /judge/next cursor, which still operate on the global overlay.

FIX: mirror the write-side pattern — lib/mcp-core.js makeCall already injects workspace into POST bodies; extend the same forwarding to GET/query calls, and convert the read routes + claim-release/judge-cursor routes to resolve per-request workspace via the same targetOverlay()/load pattern. Note: the daemon's /mcp connector transport has no per-session workspace to forward (flagged by #6 worker) — document that limitation rather than forcing it.

VERIFY: extend test/workspace-write-target.test.js (or sibling) — pin workspace B, read targeting A, assert A's graph comes back. Full suite green. Daemon restart required to activate (don't restart).

Build on commit state after task #6; coordinate with any concurrent daemon.js editors (check git status first — a heartbeat worker added /guidance dup-cluster handling mid-#6).
